worker_create_frame.cold_or_warm: warm: the framework template is loaded from the on-disk boot cache; each sample creates a session, restores the framework, launches counter.apk and requires a fresh FrameStore frame
worker_create_frame.definition: create an AgentSession from the warm boot-image cache and drive counter.apk to a published frame; reset = drop the live session and recreate it from the warm template to a fresh frame
worker_create_frame.note: M4 uses `create`; M6 uses `reset`.
